title: Grateful Dead Live at Manhattan Center on 1971-04-05

ai_review.summary: Tight, crisp soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1971 show featuring smoking Cold Rain & Snow, Other One > Wharf Rat, Going Down and Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for being clear, tight and surprisingly good even to non‑audiophiles, indicating an excellent soundboard source. The performance shines with standout renditions of Cold Rain & Snow, the Other One → Wharf Rat transition, Going Down, Not Fade Away and a ripping Lovelight, delivering a high‑energy vibe throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave five stars, highlighting both superb musical moments and excellent recording clarity; the consistent praise yields a near‑top rating with strong confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, tight and crisp sound; listeners note it 'sounds good' with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong set flow with seamless transitions, especially the Other One into Wharf Rat segment; overall pacing keeps the energy high.
